subject: English Home Language

source.topic: Time and weather: Emergent Reading and Phonics
source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'c' (hard c) sound at the beginning of words; slow-speaks words (c-a-t)

show.line: Listen. c as in cloud. c, c, cloud. Look up! Clouds in the sky. c, c, cat.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with c, as in cloud?
Say the sound with me. c, as in cat!

rounds.story: A big cloud covers the sun. It gets cold. Cebo puts on his coat. What does Cebo put on?

rounds.prompt: Slow speak with me. c, u, p. Which picture is cup?
What is this? It starts with c.
Does it start with c? Put c words in the c group.

hints: Listen for c at the start. c, c, cat.
c comes from the back of your throat, quick and quiet.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with c.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Sun starts with s. Cloud starts with c.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. c, c, cloud. Cloud starts with c!

parent_line: Can hear the c sound at the start of words.
